text:
Sam Conway: Quick check — can we tighten the weekly triage on Thursdays to 30m? Proposal: 5m hotspots, 15m bug/backlog triage, 10m rollouts & owners. Experiment also: alternate time to 9:00am PST for two weeks. Thoughts? Calendar: https://cal.example/triage

Priya Patel: +1 for 30m, 9am PST conflicts with our sprint planning for me on Thu mornings.

Diego Marquez: Prefer 8:30 or keep 10am. 9am shoves into timezone pain for EU folks.

Kai Nguyen: :thumbsup: 30m sounds good. Can we have an owners pre-read doc? I'll drop a one-pager.

Marta Li: If we compress, can we drop the deep-dive lane? Maybe run a separate 'deep triage' every other week.

Sam Conway: @Priya noted. Idea: alternate weeks at 9:00 / 10:00 so sprint-planning folks get one slot. Also need a backlog gate owner — volunteer?

Priya Patel: I can gate backlog the next two sessions.

Diego Marquez: I can own deep-triage every other Friday.

Kai Nguyen: Posted pre-read template: ```- top 5 bugs
- impact
- owner
- suggested action```

Sam Conway: :calendar: I'll update the invite to alternating times and add the compact agenda. @ops-bot can you update the recurring invite?

ops-bot: Calendarbot: recurring event updated — "Triage (alternating 09:00 / 10:00 PST Thursdays)". Invite: https://cal.example/triage

Marta Li: Small ask: add a 2-min 'safety check' for on-call handoffs at the top.

Priya Patel: Agree.

Sam Conway: Done. New compact agenda is here: https://docs.example/triage-agenda. Experiment starts next Thu. We'll review after 3 sessions. :rocket:

Diego Marquez: One more: can we enable threaded follow-ups for action items? Makes async tracking easier.

Kai Nguyen: :+1: I'll create an "action items" thread each meeting and pin the summary.

Sam Conway: Thanks all. Quick rollcall for next week: @Priya, @Diego, @Kai, @Marta, @Sam. If you're out, please ping here.

Priya Patel: Out next week AM 9/21; will join the 10am slot.

Marta Li: In.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 15m before event.
